message:
We all know that one person in our lives who seems gloriously over-prepared for anything and everything. You know, the friend who carries a mini first-aid kit in their purse and has a detailed evacuation plan for a trip to the grocery store! 

While it can be tempting to roll our eyes, there’s something to be said for that level of readiness. It reminds us that even small steps—like having a few extra bottles of water or a go-bag for the family—can bring peace of mind. 

So, while we might not need a full survivalist kit for a coffee run, maybe we can take a cue from our over-prepared pals and think about what little things we can do to be ready for life's unexpected twists. What’s one thing you can add to your own preparedness list? 😊
